text: Lesson 121.
The man in a hat.
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
Why didn't Caroline recognize the customer straight away?
zh: 为什么卡罗琳没有立刻认出那位顾客？
zh_hant: 為什麼卡羅琳沒有立刻認出那位顧客？

text: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago,
zh: 半小时前我在这儿买了两本很贵的词典，
zh_hant: 半小時前我在這兒買了兩本很貴的詞典，

text: but I forgot to take them with me.
Who served you, sir?
The lady who is standing behind the counter.
zh: 站在柜台后面的那位女士。
zh_hant: 站在櫃檯後面的那位女士。

text: Which books did you buy?
The books which are on the counter.
Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline?
zh: 卡罗琳，半小时前你招待过这位先生吗？
zh_hant: 卡羅琳，半小時前你招待過這位先生嗎？

text: He says he's the man who bought these books.
zh: 他说他就是买这些书的人。
zh_hant: 他說他就是買這些書的人。

text: I can't remember.
The man who I served was wearing a hat.
zh: 我招待的那位男人戴着帽子。
zh_hant: 我招待的那位男人戴著帽子。

text: Have you got a hat, sir?
Yes, I have.
Would you put it on, please?
All right.
Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
zh: 卡罗琳，这就是您招待的那位男人吗？
zh_hant: 卡羅琳，這就是您招待的那位男人嗎？

text: Yes.
I recognize him now.
